rules.alternatives: No CE hours. Instead each renewal must show one of: 960+ hours of nursing practice (paid or volunteer) in the past 5 years; a nursing degree earned in the past 5 years; an advanced/post-licensure nursing degree in the past 5 years; or a Board-approved refresher course in the past 5 years.
rules.audit_note: Practice hours are self-verified on the renewal application; falsified information can lead to discipline.
rules.notes: Renew every 4 years by April 1 of the renewal year (late fee after May 1; license expires August 1). Check your own due date on Nursys. Nurses short of 960 hours must take a refresher course.
